Public schooling. I have my issues with the US's public school system. San Marcos Brewery being the first but not well know, and then Stone brewery being the first well know to spring up. Port, Green Flash, Coronado, Belching Beaver, Prohibition, Karl Strauss, Latitude 33, Ballist Point, Booze Brothers, Mother Earth and some that wont show up on map quest.
